jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applied AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Cogent

Cogent is an Applied AI Lab building the next generation of AI agents for cybersecurity. AI has fundamentally changed how attacks happen, allowing malicious actors to operate at unprecedented speed and scale. Cogent’s "AI Taskforce" assesses petabytes of enterprise data to remediate these issues before critical breaches occur.

To stay at the cutting edge, we blend frontier research with real-world execution. Alongside our core product work, Cogent Research serves as our applied AI lab, providing the research horsepower needed to make truly agentic security workflows a reality.

Since coming out of stealth, Cogent has experienced rapid growth. We partner with Fortune 500 companies to secure some of the most complex production environments in the world.

We’re backed by Greylock and we’ve built a team with the best minds in applied AI. Our team is comprised of people from:

  • Top universities like Stanford, Berkeley, Penn, Duke, Carnegie Mellon, Waterloo

  • Unicorn, high-growth companies like Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, Tesla, Coinbase

  • World class cybersecurity experts from Wiz, Abnormal AI, Zscaler

  • Preeminent research labs like Deepmind and SAIL

About the Role

As we onboard our first design partners, Cogent is launching the world's first AI cyber taskforce, which is composed of AI agents capable of human-caliber reasoning for cybersecurity tasks. We are looking for talented, ambitious AI/ML Engineers who are excited to build in the Applied AI space.

What You’ll Do & Achieve

  • Architect and launch the world’s first AI Cyber Taskforce

    • Work closely with our design customers to design and launch our flagship AI agents that are capable of automating tasks in vulnerability management

    • Understand business goals, product and technology strategies, and customer requirements and implement business-critical AI systems to achieve them

    • Identify appropriate datasets and data representations to support system development

    • Decompose existing enterprise security workflows into sub-tasks that can be modeled as an autonomous system

    • Experiment with the latest advancements in long-term reasoning and planning to design systems that allows Cogent to evolve the data flywheel of our AI products from initially highly supervised to eventually autonomous and managed by exception

  • Build and extend Cogent’s Gen AI Platform

    • Implement reusable system components for ranking, retrieval and search systems powered by LLMs for agentic automation

    • Put in place frameworks to train, evaluate, and stress-test ML systems, and extend improvements on Cogent’s Gen AI platform

    • Stay on top of and when appropriate, propose incorporating cutting edge developments in ML and Gen AI into Cogent’s AI systems

  • Help create a robust engineering culture at Cogent

    • Onboard, support and uplevel future team members

    • Mentor and grow future junior team members

    • Actively contribute to Engineering Excellence, Operational Excellence and Recruiting initiatives

What You’ll Bring

  • Multiple years of relevant experience in developing and deploying AI-driven systems, with a proven track record of architecting practical, production-grade solutions that solve real-world problems

  • Expertise in machine learning, deep learning, and AI models, with a deep understanding of how to apply these technologies to build scalable, performant systems in production environments

  • Experience with designing and deploying agentic systems and autonomous agents, as well as integrating these AI components into larger applications or products

  • Ability to address and navigate real-world scale and performance challenges, ensuring that AI models and systems are efficient, robust, and performant under production constraints

  • Familiarity with cutting-edge AI technologies, including reinforcement learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and large-scale generative models

  • Proven ability to work iteratively and collaborate with cross-functional teams to evolve AI models and systems that meet evolving product needs and user expectations

  • Passion for staying at the forefront of AI advancements, continuously learning and applying emerging techniques to improve product performance and drive innovation

For California Based Applicants

The standard base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $300,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

About the Role

We are looking for Founding and Staff-level Engineers to design and implement the foundational pillars of Cogent’s data platform and integration pipeline in order to reliably ingest and normalize enterprise data sources across many corporate and IT systems and then to enable the transformation of that data into a knowledge base that can be leveraged by other GenAI systems.

What You’ll Do & Achieve

  • Build the new standard for ingesting and extracting enterprise data

    • Your role will involve building data connectors, running data pipelines, and extracting insights and context from our customer’s enterprise environments. 

    • You should get excited about building robust and secure backend systems that handle large volumes of data, ETLs, as well as reimagining how enterprise security teams should extract, store and access data.

  • Design highly performant data pipelines and indexing strategies that enable Applied AI use cases like semantic search and retrieval augmented generation

    • Work with Applied AI teams to taxonomize, correlate and deduplicate data across various enterprise sources, and architect indexing, storage and query strategies for data in Cogent’s data lake.

  • Architect the modern data platform for Gen AI

    • The LLM stack and Gen AI landscape is changing everyday. You’ll be front and center of making build vs buy decisions for various tools and services needed by the data platform, and integrating these decisions into our broader architecture and tech roadmap. 

    • Implement generalizable design patterns and system components that allow us to scale from 1 integration to thousands of integrations

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a hands-on engineer and technical leader leading multiple projects

  • Experience building data pipelines for Information Retrieval Systems (such as knowledge graphs, search engines, or similar) for enterprise use cases

  • Experience in ETL orchestration and workflow management tools (such as Temporal, Airflow) as well as building batch processing and streaming systems with tools like Apache Kafka/Flink

  • Expert in database fundamentals, SQL, data reliability practices and distributed computing

  • Experience working fluently with standard orchestration & deployment technologies like Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, Databricks, etc in multiple clouds

For California Based Applicants

The standard base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $300,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

About the Role

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to identify expansion opportunities surfaced during deployment and hand off accounts cleanly once customers are in steady state.

  • Advocate for customers internally by surfacing product gaps, documentation needs, and deployment friction to Product and Engineering.

  • Contribute to internal tooling and process improvements that scale the deployment function as Cogent grows.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role — Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Deployment Engineer, Implementation Consultant, or similar.

  • Proven track record leading technical deployments or implementations for enterprise or mid-market B2B SaaS customers.

  • Strong technical foundation: comfortable reading and discussing code, reasoning about APIs and authentication, working in the command line, and navigating cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • A bias toward ownership: when something falls between teams, you pick it up and make sure it gets done.

  • Comfort working remotely across time zones and traveling occasionally (roughly 10–20%) for customer on-sites and company gatherings.

  • Experience at a high-growth SaaS or infrastructure company during a scaling phase.

  • Background in software engineering, DevOps, or site reliability.

  • Prior experience building a deployment or onboarding function — not just executing within one.

  • Working knowledge of Python, SQL, or a scripting language you reach for to automate the tedious parts of the job.

  • Prior experience working in Cyber-Security

About Cogent

Cogent is an Applied AI Lab building the next generation of AI agents for cybersecurity. AI has fundamentally changed how attacks happen, allowing malicious actors to operate at unprecedented speed and scale. Cogent’s "AI Taskforce" assesses petabytes of enterprise data to remediate these issues before critical breaches occur.

 

To stay at the cutting edge, we blend frontier research with real-world execution. Alongside our core product work, Cogent Research serves as our applied AI lab, providing the research horsepower needed to make truly agentic security workflows a reality.

 

Since coming out of stealth, Cogent has experienced rapid growth. We partner with Fortune 500 companies to secure some of the most complex production environments in the world.

 

We’re backed by Greylock and we’ve built a team with the best minds in applied AI. Our team is comprised of people from:

  • Top universities like Stanford, Berkeley, Penn, Duke, Carnegie Mellon, Waterloo

  • Preeminent research labs like Deepmind and SAIL

  • Unicorn, high-growth companies like Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, Tesla, Coinbase

  • World class cybersecurity experts from Wiz, Abnormal AI, Zscaler

 

About the Role

Cogent Research is investing equally in two core research areas. The first is agentic security: as AI agents are deployed in production, real-world incidents have shown that prompt-level guardrails are insufficient. Agent behavior requires guarantees that are non-bypassable, AI-synthesized, and human-auditable. The second is auto-remediation: resolving security findings at machine speed in real customer environments.

Each area is a first-class research objective, and the two are deeply connected. Auto-remediation can only operate safely at the required level of autonomy when agentic security guarantees are in place. Across both areas, we combine AI with formal methods: tool calls governed by runtime-enforced policies, and code fixes that ship with machine-checkable certificates of correctness.

The Cogent AI Fellowship is an early-career research-engineering track for recently graduated, or soon-to-graduate, PhDs who want to move research from paper to production. Fellows choose a problem they are excited to pursue, prototype quickly alongside our research and engineering teams, and ship production systems. We look for people who are comfortable with ambiguity and willing to change direction when the evidence calls for it.

 
 

What You’ll Do

  • Define and pursue a research direction at the intersection of AI and formal methods, such as autoformalizing intent into machine-checkable specifications, certificate-producing code generation, AI-assisted proof in Lean, runtime verification of agent tool calls, or natural-language-to-policy synthesis.

  • Take ideas end-to-end: from prototype to systems running against real customer workloads.

  • Partner with applied AI, agent, and platform engineers to translate research advances into production capabilities.

  • Work with design partners and security leaders to ground the work in the workflows security engineers actually run.

  • Build evaluation harnesses and benchmarks that capture what “verified-correct” or “policy-compliant” means in messy, real-world security environments.

  • Iterate quickly, update your approach when results indicate a better path, and share what you learn internally and at venues that advance the field.

 

About You

  • Research experience in one or more of the following areas: formal methods, program analysis, programming languages, agentic AI for code reasoning, or runtime verification.

  • A strong publication record in top conferences or journals, or comparable open-source or artifact contributions.

  • A recently completed PhD in Computer Science, or a closely related field, or a defense expected soon.

  • Strong engineering ability, including fluency in a major programming language and the judgment to mature a prototype into a production-ready system.

  • An independent, self-starting mindset; comfort operating in ambiguous settings; and genuine excitement for Cogent’s mission.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with vulnerability detection/remediation or secure-by-construction systems.

 

For California Based Applicants

The standard base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $300,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

About the Role

As a Solutions Engineer at Cogent Security, you'll be the technical backbone of our post-sales motion - designing and scoping the vulnerability management solutions that get our most complex customers live on Cogent. You're not writing production code, but you're technical enough to speak the same language as a customer's security engineers, translate their environment into a concrete implementation plan, and write the tickets that turn that plan into reality.

This role sits within Customer Success, working alongside TAMs who own the relationship and success metrics, while you own the technical design. Over time, we want to reduce how much of this work requires a dedicated Forward Deployed Engineer for every implementation - which means the person in this seat needs deep enough domain expertise in vulnerability management to scope things right the first time.

This is a founding role for someone who's comfortable with ambiguity, has done this before at an early-stage company, and has sat across the table from CISOs and enterprise security teams.

What You'll Do

  • Scope & Design Solutions - Work directly with customer security teams to understand their environment and design how their Cogent instance should be built and deployed.

  • Bridge Technical & Product - Write clear, actionable tickets that hand off your solution design to engineering for build-out.

  • Own the Technical Relationship - Serve as the technical counterpart to the TAM, speaking the same language as customer security engineers and earning credibility with technical stakeholders up to CISO level.

  • Deploy at Enterprise Scale - Get customers live on Cogent, working with deployment teams that can span dozens of stakeholders on the customer side.

  • Scale our Forward Deployed Motion - Build repeatable scoping and design practices that shrink how much forward-deployed engineering is needed per implementation.

  • Shape What "Good" Looks Like - As an early hire on this team, help define the Solutions Architect function itself as Cogent's post-sales motion scales.

About You

  • 10+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years of deep domain expertise in vulnerability management or a closely adjacent security discipline.

  • Experience at an early-stage company - you've helped scale and build out processes from scratch, and you're comfortable operating with ambiguity rather than a fully-defined playbook.

  • A track record with enterprise-scale customers - you've worked with CISO/exec-level stakeholders and large deployment teams (e.g., 30-person implementations).

  • Management experience, including having hired and built out a team.

  • Familiarity with APIs - comfortable with API keys, reading/writing data, and validating data in a tool, even though this role doesn't involve writing PRs.

  • Excellent communication skills - able to translate fluently between customer security teams and internal engineering.

Why Cogent Security

Cogent Security is redefining how AI can proactively defend organizations against evolving threats. Our mission is to empower security teams with cutting-edge AI agents and clear, actionable insights. You’ll join a world-class GTM team where your work directly impacts the safety of some of the world’s most sophisticated organizations.

  • Make our product deployable on-prem to unlock onboarding for large customers - the last mile needed to land seven-figure accounts

  • Harden our security systems

  • Build an agent-first infra and platform layer, since agents will build our product and need a foundation they can rely on

  • Drive large-scale infrastructure projects end-to-end across a variety of stakeholders

About you

  • 5-7 years of software engineering experience with deep core infrastructure expertise and strong hands-on coding

  • Hands-on AWS experience

  • Experience with Clickhouse Cloud at the serving layer

  • Real depth in Spark and micro-batching

  • A track record of driving large-scale projects across multiple stakeholders

  • Experience building in an AI-forward capacity, with agentic coding fundamentals

  • Startup or early-stage background (up to ~200 people), ideally blended with large-company experience

jobs.title: Head of Demand Generation
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

Cogent is building autonomous cyber defense with AI agents that help security teams move from finding risk to actually fixing it. We are hiring a Head of Demand Generation to lead all pipeline-generating functions across marketing, including digital, partner, and field, and sales development.

This person will report into the Head of Growth, who owns revenue marketing and revenue operations: full-funnel revenue management in close partnership with Sales. Within that model, the Head of Demand Generation owns the front end of the revenue engine: creating, converting, and scaling qualified pipeline.

This is a senior player-coach role with room to create immediate leverage. In the first three months, you will sharpen the FY27 demand model, launch the first integrated plays, and start building your team across field/channel and digital/content so Cogent can scale pipeline with far more leverage.

Role Responsibilities

Strategy: Pipeline Planning

  • Own the pipeline generation plan across targets, source mix, budget, quarterly plays, and operating cadence.

  • Define the Lead to SQL model, including lead capture, routing, follow-up, nurture, recycle, and conversion expectations.

  • Translate ICP, account signals, category trends, partner opportunities, and sales feedback into campaigns and target-account plays.

  • Partner with Growth, Finance, Sales, RevOps, Partnerships, and Product Marketing on pipeline coverage, weighted rollover, conversion assumptions, CAC/payback, and net-new pipeline gaps.

Execution: Demand Programs

  • Scale field and channel as a core pipeline engine: repeatable event formats, regional plans, account targeting, rep/partner workflows, follow-up SLAs, and event-to-meeting reporting.

  • Build digital/content, inbound, nurture, and paid motions that amplify field/channel before, during, and after programs.

  • Turn tech alliances, channel partners, co-marketing, and co-sell motions into qualified pipeline with the internal Partnerships team.

  • Build ABM and whale-hunting plays for named accounts, including competitive replacement, category education, executive outreach, and sales follow-up.

  • Own outbound strategy: where we focus, what we test, how we message, and how outbound connects to the broader demand engine. The SDR Lead owns outbound execution.

Optimization: Funnel Performance

  • Partner with RevOps, Finance, Sales, SDR, and Partnerships to understand where the funnel is working and where it is breaking.

  • Track source performance, spend efficiency, conversion rates, follow-up quality, sales acceptance, stage progression, partner contribution, sourced/influenced pipeline, ROI, and pipeline coverage.

  • Run a weekly operating loop that tells the team what to scale, what to stop, what to fix, and what to test next.

What We Are Looking For

  • 10+ years in B2B demand generation, growth, or integrated revenue marketing, ideally in enterprise cybersecurity, infrastructure, or technical SaaS.

  • Experience owning pipeline creation targets, budget, source mix, and funnel conversion in partnership with Sales and Finance.

  • Proven ability to build a demand generation function, not just run campaigns.

  • AI-native marketer who uses agents and automation to increase speed and quality across account research, personalization, campaign production, nurture, reporting, and experimentation.

  • Strong command of field and channel program execution, sales development partnership, ABM, digital, content, webinars, partner programs, customer marketing, and executive programs.

  • Experience building demand for enterprise sales motions with technical buyers, economic buyers, long sales cycles, and multi-threaded account strategies.

  • High judgment around quality: you know the difference between activity, meetings, Sales-accepted meetings, SQLs, qualified pipeline, and revenue.

  • Comfort working inside a Growth function that owns revenue marketing and revenue operations, partnering directly with Sales, SDR, RevOps, Finance, Product Marketing, Product, Partnerships, and executive leadership.

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

Cogent is building autonomous cyber defense with AI agents that help security teams move from finding risk to actually fixing it. As our sales organization scales, we are hiring a Sales Enablement Lead to help reps ramp faster, learn the product deeply, and sell more consistently.

This role sits within the Revenue Operations arm of Growth, partnering closely with Sales leadership, Product Marketing, Product, Demand Gen, and Partnerships to improve full-funnel sales execution.

This is a hands-on builder role with immediate leverage. In the first few months, you will clean up the enablement hub, strengthen rep curriculum and certification, launch a repeatable Gong insights loop, and build the assets reps need for discovery, POVs, competitive conversations, product education, and partner-led opportunities.

Ownership Areas

Curriculum and Rep Readiness

  • Own onboarding, curriculum creation, certification, and ongoing education for AEs, SDRs, and future sales leaders.

  • Build GTM readiness programs that help reps create pipeline, progress opportunities, and communicate Cogent's value clearly.

  • Reinforce the core sales motion across discovery, qualification, POV setup, mutual plans, value story, objection handling, and handoffs.

  • Partner with Sales and RevOps on stage discipline, pipeline review follow-through, POV quality, and rep operating cadence.

Product Education and Sales Assets

  • Own the sales enablement hub and keep it current, useful, and easy for reps to navigate.

  • Build assets that help reps learn and communicate the product: pitch materials, feature explainers, release briefs, discovery guides, POV templates, competitive assets, FAQs, objection handling, call guides, customer stories, and partner briefs.

  • Partner closely with Product Marketing on new features, releases, positioning, messaging, and launch enablement.

  • Create repeatable templates for POV summaries, one-pagers, account research, partner enablement, and post-call follow-up materials.

Field Intelligence and Adoption

  • Mine Gong and field feedback for recurring themes: buyer questions, objections, competitor mentions, feature requests, POV gaps, FAQs, and product feedback.

  • Turn field learnings into updated messaging, trainings, coaching plans, product feedback loops, and sales hub updates.

  • Drive adoption of the tools and workflows reps rely on, including HubSpot, Gong, sequencing tools, the sales enablement hub, and AI-enabled workflows.

  • Track whether enablement is improving ramp, sales consistency, tool usage, POV quality, and deal progression.

What We Are Looking For

  • 6+ years in sales enablement, revenue enablement, product marketing, sales operations, or frontline sales in B2B software.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise sales motions, discovery, qualification, POVs, pipeline progression, and sales process discipline.

  • Ability to turn messy field input into clear curriculum, assets, training, and coaching.

  • Strong writing, facilitation, and program management skills across live, async, and manager-led enablement.

  • Comfort working with Gong, CRM data, dashboards, Notion or sales content systems, and AI tools.

  • High follow-through: you make sure enablement changes behavior and drives adoption, not just that a deck exists.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

Cogent is building autonomous cyber defense with AI agents that help security teams move from finding risk to actually fixing it. As our Sales team scales, we are hiring a Sales Operations Analyst to bring operational rigor to the revenue engine: pipeline hygiene, forecasting support, trusted reporting, CRM workflows, and AI-native systems that help reps and leaders run the business.

This role sits within the Revenue Operations arm of Growth and partners closely with Sales leadership, AEs/SDRs, Demand Gen, Finance, Enablement, and GTM Engineering. The mandate is to make the funnel measurable, trusted, and easier to operate while helping build a world-class AI-native revenue function.

This is a hands-on, high-leverage role. In the first few months, you will clean up core HubSpot reporting, improve pipeline and stage hygiene, support forecast/pipeline reviews, and partner with GTM Engineering to build workflows, reports, and assets that improve data quality, reduce rep admin, and show where the business is working or breaking.

Ownership Areas

Pipeline and Forecast Operations

  • Support pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and weekly revenue reporting with accurate data, clear summaries, and follow-up tracking.

  • Monitor stage progression, conversion rates, sales cycle length, deal slippage, stale opportunities, close-date hygiene, and loss reasons.

  • Partner with Sales leadership and AEs to improve pipeline inspection, deal movement, and accountability without adding unnecessary admin work.

  • Help maintain target account, territory, ownership, and routing logic as the team scales.

CRM, Data, and AI-Native Operations

  • Own day-to-day HubSpot hygiene for required fields, lifecycle/stage accuracy, source attribution, account/contact quality, and data completeness.

  • Partner with GTM Engineering to design, test, and roll out workflows that improve fill rates, enforce required fields, flag stale or low-quality data, and reduce manual cleanup.

  • Build and maintain dashboards for funnel conversion, rep activity, meetings, SQLs, POVs, pipeline, forecast, and source performance.

  • Document core GTM processes and handoffs across Demand Gen, SDR, Sales, Finance, and Enablement.

  • Use AI to accelerate data cleanup, enrichment QA, report generation, pipeline notes, account/deal summaries, and operating follow-up.

GTM Insights, Assets, and Operating Support

  • Translate messy sales data into insights the team can act on: where conversion drops, which sources progress, where deals stall, and what needs follow-up.

  • Support QBRs, pipeline reviews, board/leadership reporting, and ad hoc analysis.

  • Build lightweight operating assets such as pipeline review templates, deal inspection views, forecast notes, lead-to-SQL reports, rep follow-up trackers, and performance scorecards.

  • Partner with Demand Gen on lead-to-SQL performance and with Enablement on adoption, process gaps, rep behavior, and field feedback.

  • Use AI and automation to speed up reporting, analysis, asset creation, data cleanup, and operating follow-up while maintaining high judgment on quality.

What We Are Looking For

  • 2-4+ years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, business operations, analytics, or a similar role in B2B SaaS or technology.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS GTM metrics, pipeline mechanics, forecast support, CRM hygiene, and sales process discipline.

  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot or Salesforce, dashboards/reporting, Excel/Google Sheets, and ideally Gong, enrichment tools, or BI tools.

  • Analytical and detail-oriented, but practical: you know the goal is better decisions and cleaner execution, not reporting for reporting's sake.

  • Strong communicator who can work with Sales leaders, reps, Finance, Demand Gen, Enablement, and GTM Engineering.

  • Bias for automation and AI-enabled workflows that save time, improve data quality, improve accuracy, and make the business easier to run.

The mandate is to help turn regional programs, executive events, partner activations, and big industry moments into qualified meetings, pipeline, and stronger account relationships.

This is a hands-on execution role with real leverage. In the first few months, you will help build the field marketing operating system: event calendar, target-account planning, pre/post-event workflows, rep and partner coordination, follow-up SLAs, AI-powered logistics tracking, and reporting that shows which programs create real pipeline.

Ownership Areas

Field Strategy and Program Planning

  • Help build regional and account-based field plans aligned to pipeline targets, priority accounts, sales territories, and partner opportunities.

  • Support the right mix of executive roundtables, dinners, roadshows, conferences, partner activations, customer/prospect events, and VIP experiences.

  • Partner with Demand Gen and Sales to connect field programs to digital, content, outbound, and nurture so programs are amplified before and after the event.

  • Maintain a field calendar, program briefs, account lists, meeting goals, budgets, and success metrics.

Event Execution and Experience

  • Run end-to-end execution for assigned field programs: planning, logistics, venues/vendors, invitations, on-site experience, materials, speaker coordination, and follow-up.

  • Make every event feel high-quality, intentional, and connected to the Cogent brand.

  • Coordinate tightly with AEs, SDRs, Partnerships, and leadership so target accounts are invited, followed up with, and converted into meetings and opportunities.

  • Help build repeatable playbooks, workflows, and AI-assisted tracking systems so we can manage logistics, tasks, vendors, follow-up, and reporting across more programs without reinventing the process every time.

Pipeline Impact and Partner Activation

  • Track event performance across registration, attendance, target-account engagement, meetings, SQLs, pipeline, deal acceleration, and ROI.

  • Partner with RevOps to keep attribution, campaign membership, follow-up, and pipeline reporting clean.

  • Support co-marketing and channel activations with partners, including regional programs, deal-registration follow-up, spiffs, and better-together stories.

  • Use AI and automation to improve event research, targeting, personalized outreach, logistics tracking, task management, post-event follow-up, recap assets, and reporting.

What We Are Looking For

  • 2-4+ years in field marketing, event marketing, partner marketing, demand generation, or marketing/program operations in B2B SaaS or technology; cybersecurity interest or experience is a plus.

  • Experience supporting or running events, webinars, field programs, or partner activations tied to pipeline goals.

  • Strong project manager who can keep logistics, vendors, budgets, calendars, stakeholders, and follow-up moving.

  • Comfortable working directly with Sales and SDR teams on target accounts, invite lists, event conversion, and follow-up.

  • Good taste for customer/prospect experience and brand quality; detail-oriented enough to make programs feel polished.

  • Curious with data: willing to inspect registration, attendance, meetings, pipeline influence, ROI, and what to repeat or stop.

  • AI-forward operator who looks for ways to automate research, outreach, logistics tracking, workflows, recaps, and reporting without losing quality.

  • Willingness to travel for events and field activations as needed.

The mandate is to help turn regional programs, executive events, partner activations, and big industry moments into qualified meetings, pipeline, and stronger account relationships.

This is a hands-on execution role with real leverage. In the first few months, you will help build the field marketing operating system: event calendar, target-account planning, pre/post-event workflows, rep and partner coordination, follow-up SLAs, AI-powered logistics tracking, and reporting that shows which programs create real pipeline.




OWNERSHIP AREAS




FIELD STRATEGY AND PROGRAM PLANNING

 - Help build regional and account-based field plans aligned to pipeline targets, priority accounts, sales territories, and partner opportunities.

 - Support the right mix of executive roundtables, dinners, roadshows, conferences, partner activations, customer/prospect events, and VIP experiences.

 - Partner with Demand Gen and Sales to connect field programs to digital, content, outbound, and nurture so programs are amplified before and after the event.

 - Maintain a field calendar, program briefs, account lists, meeting goals, budgets, and success metrics.


EVENT EXECUTION AND EXPERIENCE

 - Run end-to-end execution for assigned field programs: planning, logistics, venues/vendors, invitations, on-site experience, materials, speaker coordination, and follow-up.

 - Make every event feel high-quality, intentional, and connected to the Cogent brand.

 - Coordinate tightly with AEs, SDRs, Partnerships, and leadership so target accounts are invited, followed up with, and converted into meetings and opportunities.

 - Help build repeatable playbooks, workflows, and AI-assisted tracking systems so we can manage logistics, tasks, vendors, follow-up, and reporting across more programs without reinventing the process every time.


PIPELINE IMPACT AND PARTNER ACTIVATION

 - Track event performance across registration, attendance, target-account engagement, meetings, SQLs, pipeline, deal acceleration, and ROI.

 - Partner with RevOps to keep attribution, campaign membership, follow-up, and pipeline reporting clean.

 - Support co-marketing and channel activations with partners, including regional programs, deal-registration follow-up, spiffs, and better-together stories.

 - Use AI and automation to improve event research, targeting, personalized outreach, logistics tracking, task management, post-event follow-up, recap assets, and reporting.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 2-4+ years in field marketing, event marketing, partner marketing, demand generation, or marketing/program operations in B2B SaaS or technology; cybersecurity interest or experience is a plus.

 - Experience supporting or running events, webinars, field programs, or partner activations tied to pipeline goals.

 - Strong project manager who can keep logistics, vendors, budgets, calendars, stakeholders, and follow-up moving.

 - Comfortable working directly with Sales and SDR teams on target accounts, invite lists, event conversion, and follow-up.

 - Good taste for customer/prospect experience and brand quality; detail-oriented enough to make programs feel polished.

 - Curious with data: willing to inspect registration, attendance, meetings, pipeline influence, ROI, and what to repeat or stop.

 - AI-forward operator who looks for ways to automate research, outreach, logistics tracking, workflows, recaps, and reporting without losing quality.

 - Willingness to travel for events and field activations as needed.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Cogent Security

Cogent is an Applied AI Lab building the next generation of AI agents for cybersecurity. AI has fundamentally changed how attacks happen, allowing malicious actors to operate at unprecedented speed and scale. Our AI Taskforce assesses petabytes of enterprise data to remediate these issues before critical breaches occur.

To stay at the cutting edge, we blend frontier research with real-world execution. Alongside our core product work, Cogent Research serves as our applied AI lab - providing the research needed to make agentic security workflows a reality.

Since coming out of stealth, Cogent has experienced rapid growth. We partner with Fortune 500 companies to secure some of the most complex production environments in the world.

We're backed by Greylock and our team includes people from:

  • Top universities like Stanford, Berkeley, Penn, Duke, Carnegie Mellon, and Waterloo

  • High-growth companies like Scale AI, Databricks, Stripe, Tesla, and Coinbase

  • Cybersecurity leaders from Wiz, Abnormal AI, and Zscaler

  • Research labs like DeepMind and SAIL

About the Role

We're hiring a Forward Deployed Agent Engineer, New Grad to deploy AI agents in complex customer environments and drive measurable security outcomes. This is a highly cross-functional, forward-deployed role - you'll work directly with customers to understand their needs, adapt our platform to their environment, and continuously iterate on solutions that scale to millions of real-world events.

You'll have real ownership from day one. You'll own projects end-to-end: from initial implementation and data onboarding, to deploying in production, to integrating feedback into our core agent platform. Your work will directly shape how our agents detect threats, triage incidents, and automate security workflows for enterprise organizations.

This role is built for engineers who thrive in high-impact environments, want to see the tangible results of their work in the field, and are ready to operate with autonomy from the start.

What You'll Do

  • Design & Deploy AI Agents - build security-focused AI agents that reason over large datasets, interact with security systems, and handle complex real-world workflows

  • Own Implementations End-to-End - lead technical delivery for customers, from data ingestion and transformation pipelines to configuration, workflow design, and feature extension

  • Integrate the Latest Models at Scale - experiment with, evaluate, and ship text, voice, and multi-modal models into production environments

  • Adapt to Diverse Environments - work directly with customer security teams to integrate our agents with their tools, processes, and data sources

  • Drive Platform Evolution - identify cross-customer trends and translate field insights into platform improvements and new capabilities

  • Solve Complex Technical Problems - debug deep in the stack, investigate edge cases, and ensure our agents meet enterprise-grade reliability and performance standards

What We're Looking For

  • Graduating December 2026 or Spring 2027 with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field

  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (Python, Go, TypeScript, Java, or similar)

  • Strong software fundamentals - you've built and shipped real projects (coursework, internships, or personal) and can debug what breaks, with or without AI tooling

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and non-technical contexts

  • Thrive in ambiguity, take ownership end-to-end, and prioritize customer outcomes over output

Bonus Points

  • Internship or project experience in customer-facing, forward-deployed, or consulting engineering roles

  • Exposure to early-stage startups where scope was ambiguous and you operated across functions

  • Familiarity with multi-modal AI models, enterprise SaaS, security operations, or large-scale data pipelines

For California Based Applicants

The standard base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $160,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.
